scope: Repository audit and isolated tests; no live hardware acceptance, paid operations or production deployment.

criteria.requirement:
仍未达到“所有平台可直接交付”：Windows 一次提权安装器/低权限守卫服务、持久 URC companion、
      飞行模式最终状态验收、短信页视觉验收、Linux/macOS Provider 和拔插/崩溃/换卡矩阵仍待完成。
criteria.rationale: Composite release target is not closed. Go builds/installers are delivered; cross-device radio/audio, privilege and failure matrices are not established by CI alone.

criteria.requirement: 不建立独立的远程 Modem 产品、页面或数据库体系。
criteria.rationale: Keep one Core catalog and one unified Agent product; this is a standing architecture constraint, not an unimplemented remote-modem product.

criteria.requirement: 不让浏览器或未来网络电话应用直接连接 Agent。
criteria.rationale: Mounted browser control/media use Core same-origin HTTPS/WSS, not direct Agent connections.

criteria.requirement: 不在 Agent 内实现另一套软电话、用户权限、历史记录或路由策略。
criteria.rationale: Agent owns hardware operations; Core owns business policy/history and browser owns presentation. Do not add a second business service to Agent.

criteria.requirement: 第一版不提供自动备用出口、`follow_device`、多网关集群仲裁或通用设备编排平台。
criteria.rationale: Automatic failover/follow-device clustering remains out of the first version. Retain explicit desired intent and exact routing fences.

criteria.requirement:
不为尚未遇到的网络条件预先开发复杂隧道；只有网关确实无法访问 Agent 时才补充
      所需的 TCP+UDP 反向传输。
criteria.rationale: Needed control, media, TCP/UDP and USB transports already use bounded authenticated WSS. This criterion does not require another speculative tunnel.

criteria.requirement:
保留现有 `cellular_sms.py` 和 `cellular_call.py` 作为业务入口，把直接执行 `mmcli` 的部分
      包装为本地实现，并增加返回相同领域结果的远程实现。
criteria.rationale: Python cellular_sms.py/cellular_call.py preservation is obsolete: Go-only source/install gates prohibit restoring those entrypoints. Current v1 domain behavior must be preserved instead.

criteria.requirement: 按能力拆分最小接口，避免所有设备被迫实现一个巨大的 `ModemBackend`：
criteria.rationale: Capabilities are narrow domain interfaces in Agent and Provider, with optional support. Tests exercise those boundaries; native implementations remain platform-qualified.

criteria.requirement:
业务层只使用 `operation_id`、状态和领域错误，不依赖 D-Bus path、COM 口或 Agent 请求 ID；
      本地 `modem_path/sms_path/call_path` 只能保留在实现内部。
criteria.rationale: Business commands use operation and stable target identities. Native paths are internal transport facts, not paid-operation identities.

criteria.requirement:
统一最小错误语义：`invalid`、`unavailable`、`failed`、`unknown`；`unknown` 表示操作可能已经
      到达 Modem，调用方不得自动重试可能重复计费或重复拨号的操作。
criteria.rationale: Typed failures and durable paid-operation receipts preserve uncertainty; a reconnect does not authorize a second send. Original vocabulary changed in v1 without weakening this invariant.

criteria.requirement:
Provider 可以组合实现多个小接口，但业务层不得感知 Provider 类型；能力声明来自当前
      attachment 的 Provider 实报，并携带不可用原因及是否可恢复。
criteria.rationale: Runtime/Agent interfaces compose capabilities; reports bind them to generations and exact attachments rather than guessing from model names.

criteria.requirement:
`ManagedModemService` 是无页面、无业务数据库、默认不监听 TCP 的独立 companion；Windows
      使用带 ACL 的 named pipe，其他平台使用权限受限的 Unix socket。协议为有版本、有限长的
      JSON request/response/event，MDD Agent 是唯一允许的客户端。
criteria.rationale: The old separately named ManagedModemService companion plan is superseded by the unified Go Agent and its bounded native helpers. Do not resurrect a second hardware owner.

criteria.requirement:
companion 内每个 AT function 只有一个长期存活的 libGammu state machine，统一串行化
      identity、network、SMS、USSD、call 命令并持续处理 URC；禁止每个请求启动一次 `gammu.exe`，
      禁止同时运行会打开同一端口的 Gammu SMSD/终端/第二 Agent。
criteria.rationale: The libGammu-per-function design is superseded by current Go agentat ownership and native adapters. Its serialized ownership invariant remains, not a requirement to reintroduce Gammu.

criteria.requirement:
companion 只暴露领域所需的 `probe/identity/network`、`sms.list/send/ack`、
      `call.dial/answer/hangup/status/dtmf` 和事件订阅；厂商媒体命令只能由受限 media provider
      调用，不提供任意远程 raw-AT API。
criteria.rationale: Public requests are validated domain operations, not a generic unauthenticated raw-AT command console. Preserve operation allowlists and exact targets.

criteria.requirement:
Windows 安装器一次提权安装 companion/守卫服务、固定版本依赖和卸载恢复信息；日常 Agent
      与 Web 用户不需要管理员权限。companion 链接 libGammu 时作为独立 GPL 程序分发并附许可证、
      对应源码与构建说明；MDD 通过进程外 IPC 调用，不复制或链接 GPL 代码。
criteria.rationale: A single Windows service and elevated installer exist. The old Gammu companion/license recipe is obsolete; full least-privilege service separation and event-driven installer waiting require separate design/acceptance.

criteria.requirement:
端口选择基于 PnP parent、IMEI 和无副作用能力探测；优先选择支持所需 URC 且未被系统数据栈
      占用的 AT function。COM 编号、USB interface 顺序、产品名和驱动显示名称都只是 attachment
      属性，拔插或换型号后允许变化。
criteria.rationale: Discovery uses stable equipment/attachment identities, with native port attributes kept local. Cross-vendor and multi-device selection still need hardware acceptance.

criteria.requirement:
Agent 最小状态：IMEI、ICCID、注册状态、运营商、信号、蜂窝接口、数据连接以及各项能力
      是否可用和失败原因。
criteria.rationale: Topology includes equipment/SIM/generation, network and capability facts. Unknown and unsupported are explicit; online control alone is not VoWiFi readiness.

criteria.requirement:
蜂窝接口启用后必须进入“仅 MDD 可用”的独占隔离：插入机器上的浏览器、更新器、
      EasyTier/组网软件以及其他进程，即使主动枚举或绑定该网卡，也不能使用这张 SIM 出网。
      单纯提高 metric、修改默认路由或让 SOCKS 绑定源地址都不算完成。
criteria.rationale: Linux quarantine uses nftables, device groups, cgroup ownership and socket marks/policy routes; it is not merely metric changes. Broad crash/bound-socket leak acceptance is still required.

criteria.requirement:
Linux netns/nftables 仍待实现和实机验收。macOS 不再把 PF、路由 metric 或专用账户当作
      首选安全边界；按专项 TODO 优先保证蜂窝 IP 从未进入宿主网络栈。
criteria.rationale: The literal Linux netns plan is not implemented. Current code uses nftables/cgroup/mark isolation instead; whether it satisfies the entire no-leak threat model needs the matrix. macOS private USB/IP code stays gated off by default.

criteria.requirement:
`CellularDataBackend.ensure` 负责以幂等方式建立或恢复蜂窝数据连接；本地实现复用现有
      ModemManager，远程实现请求 Agent 使用平台蜂窝接口。`status` 只报告状态，`endpoint`
      只在连接和出口健康检查均通过后返回可用入口。
criteria.rationale: Current data ownership, health/ensure and scoped reservations exist. Linux admits supported static IPv4 bearers; DHCP/PPP/IPv6 do not silently fall back to the host network.

criteria.requirement:
模块拔出或 Agent 掉线时保留 profile、国家出口分配和依赖；同一 ICCID 在任意 Agent
      重新出现且健康检查通过后自动恢复。
criteria.rationale: Persisted policy/catalog and reconnect reconciliation retain stable SIM configuration. Live SIM movement, loss and recovery must be validated across the supported hardware matrix.

criteria.requirement: SIM 选择器显示号码（如已知）、运营商、ICCID 尾号和状态；允许保存已知但离线的 SIM。
criteria.rationale: The mounted SIM selector supports known offline identities and metadata; it does not require currently online hardware to preserve configuration.

criteria.requirement: profile 状态统一派生自同一个服务端状态源：`在线`、`正在连接`、`离线`、`不可用`、`冲突`。
criteria.rationale: Shared server facts and mounted adapters provide status projections. Exhaustive five-state cross-page transitions have not been independently accepted in a real browser/device matrix.

criteria.requirement: 设备页、线路页和代理页不得各自推断一套状态；依赖出口的线路可跳转到对应 profile。
criteria.rationale: Pages share the current Go adapter and health projection; end-to-end cross-page consistency still needs acceptance, not a claim based on each page passing source tests.

criteria.requirement:
删除仍被国家出口或线路使用的 profile 前列出影响并确认；只删除代理配置，不删除 SIM、
      短信、通话或线路历史。
criteria.rationale: Deletion is dependency-aware and concerns control-plane configuration, not destructive SIM/profile writes or indiscriminate history removal. Preserve confirmation and operation identity.

criteria.requirement: Agent 上报新短信提示；服务端调用 `sms.list` 拉取并继续负责去重、Instance 归属、持久化和推送。
criteria.rationale: Current Agent event delivery and Core message persistence/deduplication exist; the old sms.list wording is not the only allowed implementation. Live receive/send matrices remain separate.

criteria.requirement:
服务端通话对象使用稳定 `call_id`；Agent 的 AT/ModemManager call path 和请求 ID 仅保留
      在当前 attachment 内部。
criteria.rationale: Stable call IDs and exact generation-scoped hardware operations are implemented, including guarded terminal ownership. Native call handles cannot choose another business call.

criteria.requirement:
未来电话应用可通过服务端受支持的 SIP/WebRTC 或实时控制接口接入；本次不实现独立电话应用，
      但 API、事件和媒体不能依赖某个浏览器页面的组件状态。
criteria.rationale: Future non-browser clients are not part of this cleanup. Current control/media APIs must keep server-owned call state; no promise of an external SIP service is made.

criteria.requirement:
Agent 将 `dial/answer/hangup/status/dtmf` 映射到当前 Provider：Windows 优先 MBN/设备服务，
      Linux 优先 ModemManager；只有 `GenericAtProvider` 才映射到标准 3GPP AT 命令。
criteria.rationale: Current native adapters include Go AT and Linux ModemManager; the original Windows MBN preference is not proof of a universal supported provider. Support is capability-gated per platform and hardware.

criteria.requirement:
来电事件必须先在服务端创建或匹配 `call_id`，再通知浏览器和未来电话客户端；客户端不得
      使用 Agent call path 接听。
criteria.rationale: Incoming operations are routed through Core-issued business call identities and exact ownership rather than exposing native paths as browser authority.

criteria.requirement: 重复、迟到或来自旧 session 的通话事件不得创建第二条通话或覆盖新 attachment 的状态。
criteria.rationale: Generation/attachment checks and event idempotency reject stale completions. Covered interleavings do not prove the undetectable reinsert HIL window is solved.

criteria.requirement:
`CallAudioBackend` 至少包含两个可独立探测的 provider：首选按同一硬件 container 精确匹配的
      UAC/WASAPI（模块自身是虚拟声卡，不要求主机有物理声卡）；Windows Audio 服务、UAC endpoint
      或打开流失败时回退 NMEA serial PCM。Linux/macOS 使用各自原生 UAC backend；未经该平台实机
      验证只上报 unavailable，不用 Windows 名称、COM 号或默认音频设备推断。
criteria.rationale: Exact-device audio helper and platform audio routes are implemented. This is not independent real-hardware acceptance of every fallback, service state or brand.

criteria.requirement:
同一 Modem 换 SIM：旧 ICCID 的 profile、线路、短信和通话历史不变并进入离线；新 ICCID
      作为新的来源出现，不能继承旧 SIM 依赖。
criteria.rationale: Stable ICCID catalog and attachment generation checks preserve old SIM history and reject replacement targets. Real SIM replacement acceptance remains outstanding.

criteria.requirement: 同一 SIM 换 Agent/Modem：重新附着原 ICCID，恢复原 profile、出口和线路，无需重新配置。
criteria.rationale: Policy/catalog use persistent SIM identity across Agent attachments. Hardware movement between hosts still requires a controlled matrix.

criteria.requirement: 网关重启：持久化配置和稳定本地入口不变；等待 Agent 重连后恢复运行时 attachment。
criteria.rationale: Persistent catalog and desired-intent reconciliation restore sessions after process start; actual deployed host and device recovery is not proven by mock or loopback tests.

criteria.requirement: Agent 断线中的未确认短信或拨号操作保持 `unknown`，不能因重连自动执行第二次。
criteria.rationale: Paid-message receipts and unknown outcomes prevent automatic duplicate resubmission across reconnect/restart within the documented scope.

criteria.requirement: 通话中 Agent 断线：服务端结束或标记失败的通话、关闭 RTP、通知所有客户端并保留记录。
criteria.rationale: Exact-call guards retain cleanup ownership and terminate or report uncertain outcomes after media/Agent loss. Hardware carrier terminal-state acceptance is not implied.

criteria.requirement: 页面业务状态只由 attachment、能力、数据连接和健康检查组合得出，不直接展示底层 socket 状态。
criteria.rationale: Mounted health presentation separates Agent presence from typed runtime/IMS/tunnel readiness and recovery scheduling.

criteria.requirement: 本地 ModemManager 的短信、通话和数据行为保持不变。
criteria.rationale: Byte-for-byte legacy Python/ModemManager behavior is not a valid migration claim after deliberate v1 and fail-closed changes. Current typed behavior is the contract; hardware parity is tracked separately.

criteria.requirement:
本地与远程实现运行同一组 `CellularDataBackend`、`SmsBackend`、`CallBackend`、
      `CallAudioBackend` 和状态结果合约测试；不声明音频能力的实现可通过明确的 unsupported
      合约结果完成 `CallAudioBackend` 测试。
criteria.rationale: Go domain contracts and optional capability tests replace the named Python interfaces. Cross-platform native equivalence still needs qualification rather than passing one platform stub.

criteria.requirement: 现有 REST API、数据库记录和 WebSocket 消息只做向后兼容扩展；不新增远程专用业务 API。
criteria.rationale: The old backward-compatible Python API/database promise was explicitly replaced by Go v1. No retired REST/SIP/VPCD endpoints should be restored under this criterion.

criteria.requirement: 代码中只有 Agent transport/adapter 可以依赖 WSS、COM 口或远程平台细节。
criteria.rationale: Keep native transport details in adapters and composition roots. WSS is also legitimately used by Core brokers; a literal ban outside Agent would contradict current architecture.

criteria.requirement: 同一 SIM 完成：Agent A 在线 -> 拔出 -> Agent B 插入 -> 原 profile 和依赖自动恢复。
criteria.rationale: Requires the actual same-SIM Agent-A to Agent-B movement test with artifact IDs and sanitized evidence. Simulated identity tests alone do not close it.

criteria.requirement: 断开蜂窝接口但保留 Agent 默认网络，验证任何测试流量都不会从默认网络泄漏。
criteria.rationale: Requires real default-network-preserved failure injection and evidence of no fallback. Existing fail-closed contracts are necessary but not a hardware leak matrix.

criteria.requirement:
在 Agent 主机启动普通浏览器及 EasyTier/同类组网进程，并测试普通 socket 与显式绑定
      蜂窝接口；它们必须全部失败，同时 MDD 的 TCP、UDP 和 DNS 代理测试仍成功。
criteria.rationale: Requires ordinary and explicitly bound TCP/UDP/DNS clients under the supported host/kernel configurations. Do not run on production without authorization.

criteria.requirement:
删除隔离规则、重启 Agent、重枚举蜂窝接口和强制结束守卫进程，验证出口立即 fail-closed，
      不会退化成“临时允许本机共用”。
criteria.rationale: Requires bounded destructive guard/rule/process/interface failure injection on a disposable host. No blanket resistance to privileged host tampering is claimed.

criteria.requirement: 多条线路可复用同一 SIM 出口；出口离线时全部 fail-closed，恢复后无需重新配置。
criteria.rationale: Stable shared-SIM egress/policy and fail-closed restoration exist; multi-line native throughput and failure acceptance remain separate.

criteria.requirement: 远程短信可以发送、接收、持久化和推送，且沿用现有 UI。
criteria.rationale: Go send/receive/persistence and mounted UI are present. Historical paid-operation reports are not independently repeated live acceptance here.

criteria.requirement: 验证发送超时、重复响应、旧 session 响应、断线补扫和消息去重。
criteria.rationale: Current tests exercise stable operation identity, unknown outcomes, reconnect, duplicate responses and stale targets. Carrier-side behavior remains external.

criteria.requirement:
浏览器可以通过远程 Modem 拨号、接听、挂断和发送 DTMF：呼出、挂断和双向语音已实机
      通过；来电事件与接听界面已实机验证，实际接听仍待人工验收；DTMF 等待通话中人工验收。
criteria.rationale: Dial/answer/hangup/DTMF paths exist. This review does not perform paid calls or certify live answering/DTMF without explicit authorization.

criteria.requirement:
有音频能力的 Modem 完成浏览器双向语音、静音和录音验证：呼出双向语音已通过，来电、
      静音和录音仍待人工验收。
criteria.rationale: Current media and mute controls exist; audio recording is not implemented in the mounted UI. Removing the retired recording stub does not deliver recording. Live media/mute acceptance also remains open.

criteria.requirement:
来电可以同时通知多个已登录客户端，但只有服务端接受的首次接听生效，其他客户端同步进入
      已由其他端接听的状态。
criteria.rationale: Server-side single-call admission and first-owner conflicts exist. Multi-browser real incoming-call races require field acceptance before marking this criterion complete.

criteria.requirement:
通话期间刷新浏览器页面或另一个客户端接入后，可以从服务端恢复当前通话状态，而不是依赖
      原页面内存。
criteria.rationale: The mounted session-level coordinator survives page navigation and reads server call state. Seamless cross-browser media transfer/reload acceptance is not inferred from that architecture alone.

criteria.requirement: Agent 在振铃、接通和通话中断线时，服务端、浏览器、Asterisk 和录音资源最终状态一致。
criteria.rationale: Current resources are Core/Agent/Go Provider and browser media; Asterisk is retired and recording is absent. The remaining real disconnect-phase matrix stays open.

criteria.requirement: 无音频能力时验证 UI 不会误导用户可以进行双向语音。
criteria.rationale: Current preflight requires authoritative capability and fresh bidirectional browser media evidence before paid submission. Unknown/unavailable is not displayed as proven audio.

criteria.requirement:
验证在线、正在连接、离线、不可用和冲突状态，以及离线 SIM 可配置、删除依赖警告和
      跨页面状态一致性。
criteria.rationale: Run actual five-state transitions, offline selection and dependency prompts across mounted pages. Unit/source contracts are recorded but do not certify this visual/field matrix.

criteria.requirement: 为互不互通的多个 LAN/VPN 客户端增加标准 TURN 配置（浏览器和 Asterisk 共用同一受管凭据），不能用重复 `ice_host_candidates`、默认路由或固定网段伪装多宿主支持。
criteria.rationale: Current browser media is same-origin WSS to Core/Provider, not the retired Asterisk WebRTC/TURN path. Do not add an unused TURN service to satisfy an obsolete architecture task.

criteria.requirement: 把 VoWiFi UA 提升为登录会话级 CallCoordinator，使浏览器在通话页以外仍能收到真实 SIP 来电并接听；页面只订阅同一会话，不创建第二个 UA。
criteria.rationale: mdd/App.jsx mounts one root useGoCallCoordinator for the logged-in session; pages subscribe instead of mounting another owner. The duplicate unmounted coordinator has been removed.

criteria.requirement: TURN 完成后分别验收反向代理/NAT/IPv6；在此之前这些入口应明确提示需要 TURN，不能误报为已验证。
criteria.rationale: The prerequisite TURN design is superseded by same-origin WSS. Reverse proxy/NAT/IPv6 reachability and live-media acceptance still require explicit scenarios; no multi-host guarantee is invented.

criteria.requirement:
复用现有 SMS/Call 领域合约已验证列表与状态读取；本轮未重复发送收费短信、未拨号，也未重做
  来电接听，因此发送/接收/通话端到端保持待人工授权验收。任何 unknown 均不自动重试。
criteria.rationale: Native SMS/call contracts have source tests; no additional paid SMS/call or bidirectional carrier/media validation was performed in this audit.

criteria.requirement: universal、公证与 CI release 尚未完成；当前 Developer ID 签名不能冒充已 notarize。
criteria.rationale: macOS arm64 release CI and signing flow exist. Universal packaging and notarization remain unfinished; passing an arm64 build does not establish either.

criteria.requirement:
runtime snapshot、配置、控制 session、数据 backend 与设备列表已由单数 `modem` 改为按
  `ModemInstanceIdentity` 索引的集合；至少 2 个 Modem 同时在线，分别插拔、换卡、断线和恢复时
  互不影响仍缺第二台物理 Modem 验证。首个 PoC 的单 Modem 限制不得泄漏进公共领域合约。
criteria.rationale: Requires two simultaneous distinguishable physical modems, independent control/data/teardown and associated artifact/firmware evidence.

criteria.requirement:
至少当前 EC20+多 PC/SC Mac 与另一品牌/协议 Modem 交叉验证；没有第二种硬件时只能标注已验
  型号，不宣称通用 4G/5G 数据已完成，也不能把“可实例化”写成“多 Modem 已验收”。
criteria.rationale: Requires a second vendor or supported protocol qualification. The default modem-disabled boundary remains until that acceptance is established.

workstreams.summary: Required Android unified-protocol reader/OMAPI/OTG product support is not delivered. Retired VPCD APK is not an implementation.
workstreams.acceptance: Define protocol/security/native permissions, implement and test on authorized devices; do not claim code from a README badge.

workstreams.summary: Current standard delete with retained notification is a transition, not the requested custom deletion behavior.
workstreams.acceptance: User explicitly requested this last and interactive. Design/review and authorize exact-card destructive tests separately.

workstreams.summary: Recording is not delivered by current browser call controls; removal of an old UI stub is cleanup only.
workstreams.acceptance: Define explicit consent, storage/retention/security and lifecycle semantics, implement, then authorize real acceptance.

workstreams.summary: Go installers exist, but lifecycle waiting still includes bounded polling; event-driven/cancellation improvements and least-privilege architecture remain a separate work item.
workstreams.acceptance: Verify exact polling paths on Windows/macOS before changing them; retain bounded waits and error diagnostics.

workstreams.summary: A SIM unplug/reinsert with identical observed USB/ICCID/owner between samples cannot be certified by ordinary snapshot tests.
workstreams.acceptance: Native event/generation evidence and narrowly timed real HIL on all supported platforms; report uncertainty when indistinguishable.

workstreams.summary: Historical forced-close root cause remains unknown. Current Linux ModemManager access is private D-Bus, not an mmcli subprocess whose stderr can simply be recovered.
